spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (PLAYING: duplicate Subscribe -> non-fatal Error(402, retryable=false), connection maintained)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §5.2 (error response classes: the non-fatal Error class)
description: The non-fatal 402: a duplicate Subscribe in PLAYING gets Error(402) ONLY — no Close, connection kept, state unchanged; the next request is still served, which the follow-up RequestConfiguration proves.
preconditions: State PLAYING: subscribed, stream instance 1 active (config_generation 1). The original Subscribe consumed request_id 1.
Isolated continuation; this duplicate arrives as request_id 2.

steps.note: Non-fatal: NO paired Close; the connection is maintained.

assertions: Error(402) echoes request_id 2; Status retryable=false, requires_repairing=false (§6.2 defaults).
No Close frame and no transport close: the connection is maintained and processing continues — the defining property of the non-fatal Error class (spec §5.2).
State does not change (stays PLAYING); the same 402-only reply applies to a duplicate Subscribe in READY.
Fatality is a property of the state-machine row, never of the code alone: 402 is fatal (Error+Close) for structural violations — see control.subscribe-before-ready-402.
